anonymous_allow_ips_comment: Sources allowed to call inference routes without a managed key. Empty requires a key from every caller.
grok_comment: Grok uses only the Build CLI upstream. Add accounts through /api/grok/device-auth; OAuth access and refresh tokens are managed by the server.
qoder_queue_retry_comment: Qoder free-tier gates every account on one shared upstream queue (business code 10605), so switching accounts does not help and the request has to outlast the gate instead. Probe every qoder_queue_retry_interval_ms and keep waiting up to shared_refusal_wait_budget_ms. max_retries and first_token_timeout_seconds must be large enough that one request survives a full 30s window while shared_refusal_wait_budget_ms stays at or below the 60s edge-safe ceiling, so an edge proxy with a 100s origin timeout does not cut off an answer the gateway was about to return.
